verdict.rationale: Smooth's own documented capabilities support unattended programmatic automation: a REST API for running tasks and sessions, a 4-line SDK `run` call, a polling-based status model, and a CLI that works with any agent able to run commands. Nothing documents CI-pipeline usage, so headless/CI execution is implied rather than shown. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), documented non-interactive API-key auth for CI runners (browser profiles require a manual login), exit-code or headless-mode CLI behavior, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Smooth API enables programmatic browser automation through REST endpoints.
Run a task in just 4 lines of code, making it easy to integrate into your workflow.
Smooth CLI works with any agent that can run CLI commands.
The API uses polling rather than webhooks or WebSockets
